senses.gloss: mark, sign, emblem; test, signal, military ensign. Ḥag. 16ᵃ (play on ואתה Deut. XXXIII, 2; cmp. foreg.) אות הוא וכ׳ He is the ensign among his myriad; v. דּוּגְמָא.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:7">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אל תזניחנו בא׳ וכ׳</he> forsake us not in the symbolic trial of bitter waters (in our trials). Pl. <he>אוֹתוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:10">Kil. IX, 10</cite> <he>א׳ הגרדין וכ׳</he> the marks which the weavers &c. put on goods in their charge.
B. Kam. 119ᵇ you must not buy from the dyer לא א׳ ולא דוגמות either tests (pieces cut off to test the color) or samples (as specimens of color).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 15a:5">B. Bath. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>אות אחת</he> one letter.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 30a:11">Kidd. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>סופרים כל הא׳</he> recorded (or counted) all the letters of the Torah.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 10:1">Snh. X, 1</cite> <he>השם באוֹתִיוֹתָיו</he> the Divine Name with the letters in which it is written (Jehovah).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71a:13">Kidd. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>שם בן ארבע א׳</he> the quadriliteral Name; cmp. <cite ref="U01408"><he>שֵׁם</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:1">Lev. R. s. 26</cite>, beg. <he>ח׳ א׳</he> eight letters.
Sabb. XII, 3; a. fr.—Trnsf. notes, documents.
